children.zh-CN: 触发元素。传函数时参数为 `getTriggerProps`，把 `getTriggerProps(自有属性)` 的结果展开到接收焦点的元素上；其他内容会被 Tooltip 包进一个 span 作为触发元素。
children.en-US: The trigger. A function receives `getTriggerProps`; spread `getTriggerProps(ownProps)` on the element that takes focus. Anything else is wrapped in a span owned by Tooltip.

content.zh-CN: 弹出层内容，可以是元素，或返回元素的函数；函数的参数含 `initialFocusRef`，用于指定弹出层打开后获得焦点的元素。
content.en-US: Popup content: an element, or a function returning one. The function receives `initialFocusRef` to name the element that takes focus once the popup opens.

style.zh-CN: 弹出层的内联样式；箭头颜色只读取对象形式中的 `background-color`。
style.en-US: Inline style of the popup. The arrow color reads `background-color` of an object style only.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 弹出层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the popup flips automatically when it would be clipped.

position.zh-CN: 弹出层相对触发元素的位置。
position.en-US: Position of the popup relative to the trigger element.

prefixCls.zh-CN: 弹出层类名前缀，设置后弹出层不再带 Tooltip 的样式。
prefixCls.en-US: Class prefix of the popup. A custom value drops the Tooltip styles.

spacing.zh-CN: 弹出层与触发元素的距离，单位为像素；对象形式分别设置水平与垂直方向。
spacing.en-US: Distance in pixels between the popup and the trigger. An object sets the horizontal and vertical distances.

showArrow.zh-CN: 是否显示箭头三角形，也可以传入元素作为自定义箭头。
showArrow.en-US: Whether the arrow is shown. An element renders as a custom arrow.

aria-label.zh-CN: 弹出层 role 为 dialog 时的 aria-label，其他 role 下忽略。
aria-label.en-US: aria-label of the popup when its role is dialog; ignored for other roles.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 弹出层 role 为 dialog 时的 aria-labelledby，其他 role 下忽略。
aria-labelledby.en-US: aria-labelledby of the popup when its role is dialog; ignored for other roles.

arrowPointAtCenter.zh-CN: 箭头是否指向触发元素中心，需要同时开启 showArrow。
arrowPointAtCenter.en-US: Whether the arrow points at the center of the trigger. Requires showArrow.

wrapWhenSpecial.zh-CN: 触发元素禁用或加载中时，是否在外层包裹 span 以保证触发行为。
wrapWhenSpecial.en-US: Whether a disabled or loading trigger is wrapped in a span so that it still triggers the popup.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的 click、mousedown 与焦点进出事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click, mousedown and focus in/out events on the popup stop propagating.

wrapperClassName.zh-CN: 触发元素被 span 包裹时，该 span 的类名。
wrapperClassName.en-US: Class name of the span that wraps the trigger when a wrapper is needed.

wrapperId.zh-CN: 弹出层节点的 id，触发元素的 aria 属性指向它；缺省时自动生成。
wrapperId.en-US: id of the popup element, referenced by the trigger's ARIA attributes. Generated when omitted.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留弹出层内容而不销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the popup content stays mounted while closed.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 点击弹出层及其内部任一元素时是否关闭弹出层。
clickToHide.en-US: Whether a click on the popup or anything inside it closes the popup.

clickTriggerToHide.zh-CN: 点击触发元素时是否关闭已打开的弹出层。
clickTriggerToHide.en-US: Whether a click on the trigger closes an open popup.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 弹出层打开期间按 Esc 是否关闭弹出层；trigger 为 custom 时只调用 onEscKeyDown，由使用方决定是否关闭。
closeOnEsc.en-US: Whether Esc closes the open popup. With trigger custom it only calls onEscKeyDown and the caller decides whether to close.

condition.zh-CN: 是否允许触发显示；仅显式设为 false 时，hover、click、focus 等触发行为不生效，trigger 为 custom 时仍按 visible 显示。由 true 变为 false 时立即关闭已显示的弹出层；visible 受控时只调用 onVisibleChange(false)，使用方回写后才关闭。
condition.en-US: Whether the popup may be triggered. Only an explicit false disables the hover, click and focus triggers; with trigger custom, visible still shows the popup. Changing it from true to false closes an open popup at once; with a controlled visible it only calls onVisibleChange(false), and the popup closes once the caller writes back.

disableArrowKeyDown.zh-CN: 是否禁用在触发元素上按方向键把焦点移入弹出层。
disableArrowKeyDown.en-US: Whether the arrow keys on the trigger are prevented from moving focus into the popup.

disableFocusListener.zh-CN: trigger 为 hover 时，是否不响应键盘聚焦打开弹出层。
disableFocusListener.en-US: Whether keyboard focus is ignored when trigger is hover.

guardFocus.zh-CN: 焦点位于弹出层内时，Tab 是否在弹出层内循环。
guardFocus.en-US: Whether Tab cycles inside the popup while focus is in it.

mouseEnterDelay.zh-CN: 指针移入后延迟显示的毫秒数，仅 trigger 为 hover 或 focus 时生效。
mouseEnterDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before the popup shows after the pointer enters. Applies to the hover and focus triggers.

mouseLeaveDelay.zh-CN: 指针移出后延迟隐藏的毫秒数，仅 trigger 为 hover 或 focus 时生效，不小于 mouseEnterDelay。
mouseLeaveDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before the popup hides after the pointer leaves. Applies to the hover and focus triggers; not less than mouseEnterDelay.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动到被聚焦元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing an element avoids scrolling it into view.

returnFocusOnClose.zh-CN: 弹出层关闭后焦点是否回到触发元素。
returnFocusOnClose.en-US: Whether focus returns to the trigger after the popup closes.

trigger.zh-CN: 触发显示的时机。custom 时显示与否完全由 visible 决定。
trigger.en-US: When the popup shows. With custom, visible alone decides.

visible.zh-CN: 弹出层是否显示（受控）。传入后触发器、点击外部与 Esc 只通过 onVisibleChange 请求打开或关闭，使用方回写后才生效。
visible.en-US: Whether the popup is shown (controlled). When given, the trigger, outside clicks and Esc only request a change through onVisibleChange, which takes effect once the caller writes it back.

onVisibleChange.zh-CN: 弹出层显示状态变化时调用；visible 受控时只报告用户交互发起的请求，使用方自己改变 visible 不调用。
onVisibleChange.en-US: Called when the visibility of the popup changes; with a controlled visible it reports only requests from user interaction, not changes the caller makes to visible.

onClickOutSide.zh-CN: 弹出层打开时在触发元素与弹出层以外的区域按下鼠标时调用，参数为原生 `MouseEvent`，仅 trigger 为 click、contextMenu、custom 或开启 clickTriggerToHide 时有效。
onClickOutSide.en-US: Called when the mouse is pressed outside of the trigger and the open popup, with the native `MouseEvent`. Only for trigger click, contextMenu or custom, or with clickTriggerToHide.

onEscKeyDown.zh-CN: closeOnEsc 为 true 时，弹出层打开期间按 Esc 调用，参数为原生 `KeyboardEvent`。
onEscKeyDown.en-US: Called with the native `KeyboardEvent` when Esc is pressed while the popup is open and closeOnEsc is true.

onOpen.zh-CN: 弹出层显示、进场动画开始时调用，每次打开一次，早于 afterOpen，受控与非受控相同；悬停打开后指针已离开而撤回的打开不调用。
onOpen.en-US: Called once per opening when the popup is shown, as its enter animation starts, before afterOpen, controlled or not; not called for a hover open withdrawn because the pointer already left.

afterOpen.zh-CN: 弹出层打开且进场动画结束后调用；没有进场动画时打开后即调用；进场结束前被关闭的打开不调用。
afterOpen.en-US: Called after the popup has opened and its enter animation has finished, or right after opening when there is no enter animation; not called for an open that is closed before the enter animation ends.

afterClose.zh-CN: 弹出层关闭且离场动画结束后调用。
afterClose.en-US: Called after the popup has closed and its leave animation has finished.

ref.zh-CN: 获取组件实例方法，见下方 Methods。
ref.en-US: Receives the instance methods listed under Methods below.

focusTrigger.zh-CN: 让触发元素获得焦点，仅在 `returnFocusOnClose` 为 true 且 trigger 不是 `custom` 时生效。
focusTrigger.en-US: Focuses the trigger. Only works when `returnFocusOnClose` is true and trigger is not `custom`.

getPopupId.en-US: Returns the id of the popup.

hide.zh-CN: 立即关闭弹出层，不移动焦点，并调用 `onVisibleChange(false)`；`visible` 受控时只调用 `onVisibleChange(false)`，使用方回写后才关闭。
hide.en-US: Closes the popup at once without moving focus and calls `onVisibleChange(false)`. With a controlled `visible` it only calls `onVisibleChange(false)`, and the popup closes once the caller writes back.

rePosition.zh-CN: 按触发器当前位置立即重新计算弹出层位置。弹出层已随滚动、窗口尺寸变化、触发器移动以及触发器或弹出层的尺寸变化自动重新定位，一般无需调用；跟随触发器移动会晚一帧，需要同一帧内对齐时调用。
rePosition.en-US: Recomputes the popup position from the trigger's current position at once. The popup already follows scrolling, window resizing, trigger moves and size changes of the trigger or popup, so this is rarely needed; following a trigger move lands a frame late, so call this to align within the same frame.
